sources.title: How retention is measured in vertical SaaS, and why the figures diverge
sources.snippet: All-customer net revenue retention in vertical SaaS benchmarks at 104-112%. A cohort restricted to customers past their first renewal typically reports 25-40 points higher than the all-customer figure for the same business, because the customers most likely to churn have already been excluded from the denominator. Benchmarks are published on the all-customer basis, so the two are not comparable.

sources.title: First-year attrition in pharmacy operations software
sources.snippet: First-year logo churn in software sold to independent pharmacy operators runs 30-35%, and is concentrated before the first renewal. Implementations that fail typically fail during the initial data migration from the wholesaler's ordering system.

sources.title: Independent pharmacy groups in North America
sources.snippet: There are approximately 21,000-23,000 independent pharmacy groups in North America. The count has declined 3-4% annually for six years as groups are acquired by regional chains.

sources.title: Wholesaler reorder tooling
sources.snippet: The three national pharmaceutical wholesalers each supply inventory reordering tools to their customers at no charge as part of the distribution agreement. Independent analyses describe these tools as optimising for wholesaler fill rates rather than for pharmacy margin, but note that their zero price makes them the default option for smaller groups.
